newsitem.title: UK: UK Thorn sees year profits unchanged but wary.
newsitem.headline: UK Thorn sees year profits unchanged but wary.

text.p: British electrical retailer Thorn Plc said on Monday that full year profits before tax and exceptionals will be broadly unchanged from last year's pro forma equivalent of 170.7 million pounds ($285.5 million).
It also said that profit before tax and exceptionals for the nine months ended December 31, 1996 was up eight percent on last year's pro forma to stand at 123.0 million stg.

Thorn warned fourth quarter results would be hit by the volume performance over the christmas season, particularly its U.S. business where electronics retailers have reported a significant comparable drop in store sales over christmas.
The electrical retailer and rental firm also cautioned the continuing strength of sterling was likely to damage fourth quarter non-UK profits by around 10 percent.
Thorn, which separated from its music partner EMI in August 1996, said that new business levels were mixed over the third quarter across its main markets in the U.S., the UK and the Nordic region.
Turnover for the nine month period rose five percent to 1.19 billion pounds. Thorn said that more detailed results for the nine month period will be made available on February 24.
By 0932 GMT, shares in the company had fallen 27 pence to stand at 224-1/2 pence.
